sources.title: PBO Budget MCP — source definitions
sources.evidenceNote: Manual identifies GFMIS annual line-item disbursement files; amounts are million THB. Adjusted budget, disbursement and PO are separate columns; source dashes represent missing values, not zero. Geographic matching in CityMETER is a separate step.
sources.upstreamInstitution: not separately established by this audit

sources.title: Open-data event and published collection
sources.publisher: House of Representatives budget monitoring committee (event attribution); Thaith (website)
sources.evidenceNote: Public event page points to the source collection and PBO manual. Collection-file identifiers and internal acquisition metadata are deliberately omitted here.

sources.title: Government Workforce 2567
sources.publisher: Office of the Civil Service Commission (OCSC), Information and Communication Technology Center
sources.evidenceNote: 169-page public PDF; broad public-workforce report. Its population is not interchangeable with ordinary civil servants in dataset_32_02. Report rights statement is not an open licence for all embedded media.

sources.title: Ordinary civil-servant workforce 2567 resource metadata
sources.publisher: OCSC Information and Communication Technology Center
sources.evidenceNote: Resource explicitly defines people as unit and links the checked CSV. Metadata updated 2 September 2025, which is not the data reference year.

sources.title: Government-agency addresses and contacts

sources.evidenceNote: Department-level address/contact dictionary; compiled from agency websites and the DGA central-email directory. Address records do not establish local staffing, service boundaries or current availability.

sources.title: Government and important places in 76 provinces
sources.publisherRole: upstream_producer; GD Catalog is the discovery mirror
sources.evidenceNote: GD Catalog explicitly credits DOPA and links its original catalog. Scope includes government and other important places such as schools and religious sites; not every record is a government office.

sources.title: Government offices and ministries in Bangkok
sources.publisherRole: portal_publisher; source field states Bangkok statistics
sources.evidenceNote: Metadata credits the Geographic Information Division contact and Digital Strategy Division creation. Dataset record created/updated 9 March 2021; no separate observation date established. Licence unspecified.

sources.evidenceNote: Bangkok record CSV contains addresses, district codes and X/Y coordinates, but no staffing counts. Do not interpret X/Y as longitude/latitude without CRS verification. Parent catalog credits the City Planning and Urban Development Department; licence unspecified.

sources.evidenceNote: Bangkok record CSV contains addresses, district codes and X/Y coordinates, but no staffing counts. Do not interpret X/Y as longitude/latitude without CRS verification. sources.title: Local Fire Department Standard
sources.publisherRole: reference_document_host; not a workforce data producer
sources.evidenceNote: Document provides service standards, not observations of staffing at a particular fire station. Do not convert prescribed staffing into measured headcount.

sources.title: Position establishment — Ministry of Justice offices
sources.publisher: National Housing Information Center (catalog host); Ministry of Justice offices (document subject)
sources.publisherRole: catalog_mirror; original publishing office not separately verified
sources.evidenceNote: Resource lists position IDs, positions, unit, province and position status. This is not National Housing Authority workforce merely because it appears on the NHA host.

sources.title: Judicial appointment establishment — 1 April 2021
sources.publisher: Office of the Judicial Commission, Courts of Justice
sources.evidenceNote: Page published 30 November 2020, listing high-court and first-instance vacancies for the appointment term. Establishment/vacancies are not occupied staff counts or a current staffing census.

globalConstraints: Reference-year and publisher metadata are distinct.
Headcount, authorised positions, vacancies, service standards and mapped locations must not be added together.
A checked source URL does not prove the map uses the exact checked release.
Public catalog references contain no private collection IDs, contact emails, raw attachment metadata or authenticated links.
